title: ask-graph golden tests leave 3 branches unpinned: three mutants survive
detail: Mutating packages/ask/src/ask-graph.ts survived the whole ask-graph.test.ts for: (a) dropping web sources from boundedSources (bounded mode + tavily success is never run, only unavailable/empty), (b) removing the candidates.slice(0, SOURCE_LIMITS.candidates) bound plus its ask.candidates_bounded audit (no scenario exceeds SOURCE_LIMITS.candidates), (c) ignoring deps.scoreFnForComplete (no scenario sets it, so the loggingComplete('score') path and the skipped ask.score audit are untested). Also uncovered: legacy tavily returning [] (non-bounded), hydrate().degraded, completionBudget assertHealthy refusal, and a non-BoundedAskError wrapped to 'source or completion processing failed' in bounded mode.
fix_direction: Add golden scenarios: bounded + tavily returning a web result; bounded tree with more than SOURCE_LIMITS.candidates nodes; scoreFnForComplete set; hydrate degraded; legacy tavily []; bounded non-BoundedAskError from complete. Re-run the three mutants and confirm killed.

title: askV2 body duplicated, not shared: drift between askV2 and graph is caught only where a scenario exists
detail: ask-graph.ts copies ~150 lines of runAskV2 (webDocText, collectNodesById, loggingComplete, every branch). The golden harness does run both paths on identical fixtures, so a change to askV2 fails the suite for covered branches, but any change to an uncovered branch (see ISS-T050ASKGRAPH-001) diverges silently. Existing askV2 tests do not touch the graph.
fix_direction: Before any switch-over (T-050 wiring), refactor askV2 to be the graph run (askV2 = runAskGraphNodes over shared node functions), or at minimum close ISS-T050ASKGRAPH-001 and add a source-text drift test. Do not switch routes while duplicated.
